title: My Brother Is Trapped Inside Our Bathroom Mirror
cta: BREAK IT or KEEP IT LOCKED? Top comment decides Part 2
description:
BREAK IT: save my brother and risk releasing whatever is behind him.
KEEP IT LOCKED: protect everyone outside and leave him with that thing.
Choose, and tell me why. The top comment becomes my decision in Part 2.

The Mirror Is a Lock, Part 1. A CreepyCartoonTales story.
lines: My little brother is trapped inside our bathroom mirror.
Every night, the thing behind him gets closer.
Tonight, its hands reached his shoulders.
He pressed a note to the glass. "Break it before midnight."
Mum grabbed my wrist, and played Dad's last recording.
"He's alive. But that mirror is a lock. Break it, and everything behind him gets out."
In the glass, my brother started crying. "You promised you'd never leave me."
Every neighbour on our street was standing at a window. Watching our house. Smiling.
*Then my brother whispered, "If they're already outside... what are you keeping locked in?"
The clock began to strike twelve.
